name: Jishbak
title: Abraham's son by Keturah
summary: Jishbak was one of the six sons Abraham had with his wife Keturah after Sarah's death. He became the ancestor of a people in northern Arabia or the Syria region. Abraham gave him gifts and sent him east, away from Isaac.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Jishbak
keyEvents.description: Jishbak was born as one of Abraham's six sons by Keturah, mentioned as the fifth in the line of brothers.

keyEvents.title: Sent eastward with gifts
keyEvents.description: Abraham gave gifts to Jisbak and his brothers and sent them eastward, away from Isaac who was the primary heir, while Abraham was still alive.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jisbak is mentioned again in the genealogies of Chronicles as one of Keturah's sons by Abraham.
